title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - CommunicatingFunction
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/CommunicatingFunction. A function that allows a device to communicate with another device. Subclass of NotifyingFunction (itself a subclass of saref:EventFunction), per the SAREF4WEAR ontology (ETSI TS 103 410-9 clause 4.2.4). The ontology declares no own property for this class beyond the classification itself; communicationProtocol is added for a usable candidate model.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'CommunicatingFunction'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

communicationProtocol.description: Property. Open-vocabulary protocol used by this communicating function, e.g. 'BLE', 'WiFi', 'LoRaWAN'.
